objective: Finite no-model method test of prospective session-level route diversification against best-mean reactive fallback under delayed hidden regime change, with observable, shared-failure, stable, idle-readiness, route-carryover, and no-eligible-route controls.
unit: One complete independently reset eight-task session-policy sequence; every offered task remains in the denominator. Matched policy sequences share only declared scenario, onset, and preselected allocation mask. All route state resets at each session boundary.

fixed_design.mixture: uniform exhaustive enumeration of all 28 masks selecting exactly two B slots from eight per session
fixed_design.A_detection_rule: three consecutive unresolved outcomes; switch to qualified B on the next task
fixed_design.tail_endpoint: session has at least three unresolved/YIELD tasks
fixed_design.regime_truth: available to the scoring-only auditor; not to hidden-regime policy decisions

interpretation: Synthetic method result only. No route is qualified for a real GUI by this fixture; no agent, model, desktop, runtime or live action is used. PASS cannot establish an empirical interface effect or justify real-task randomization.
